definitions.explanation: The act of appearing or coming into existence. Used for phenomena, creatures, people, or things that appear on the scene, often with a sense of something notable or unexpected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出現|しゅつげん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出現|しゅつげん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A rare bird appeared in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出現|しゅつげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝|つた}わり→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: With the emergence of the internet, the way information spreads changed dramatically.

notes:
{出現|しゅつげん} describes something notable appearing or coming into existence — a new technology, phenomenon, creature, or significant figure.

FORMS:
{出|しゅつ} (come out) + ⟦{現|げん}→現〜：03950_gen⟧ (appear, manifest).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧{出現|しゅつげん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appear suddenly
- {新種|しんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出現|しゅつげん}: emergence of a new species
- {出現|しゅつげん}⟦{頻度|ひんど}→頻度：14619_hindo⟧: frequency of appearance
- {出現|しゅつげん}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: appearance rate
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出現|しゅつげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: with the emergence of ~

REGISTER:
Formal and written. In everyday speech, ⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧ (to appear) or ⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧ (to come out) are more natural.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出現|しゅつげん}: appearance of something notable or significant (formal)
- ⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧: entrance, debut (often for people, characters)
- ⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧: occurrence, outbreak (for events, disasters, problems)
